description: This file contains LESS mixins for styling form validation states, including validation feedback, focus states, and sizing configurations for form controls in a Bootstrap-based project.

methods.name: form-control-validation
methods.description: Defines styles for form validation states including labels, help texts, input borders, and feedback icons with customizable color, border, and background.

methods.name: form-control-focus
methods.description: Provides a mixin to generate focus styles for input controls, including border and box-shadow effects with customizable color.

methods.name: input-size
methods.description: Configures sizing, padding, font size, and border-radius for form control elements, including select and textarea elements.
